correction_findings.finding: The F0 journey temporarily changed State.pageData.page.iam_role to comment and rendered pageCommentPreview before capture, then restored only the role while leaving the rendered preview DOM visible.
correction_findings.resolution: The mutation and preview wait were removed from f0_p5_browser.py; a static regression guard now rejects both mutation tokens in the product capture journey.

correction_findings.finding: R5 was independently reverified after product and capture sources had changed. It then reported candidate environment and release-candidate binding errors in addition to the expected visual, Core-25, performance, and claims failures.
correction_findings.resolution: R5 remains immutable historical diagnostic evidence and cannot be promoted as evidence for the current build. A fresh successor run is required.

correction_findings.finding: The product collector imported two small helpers from the legacy reference-shaped capture module even though it did not invoke that module's visual mutation code.
correction_findings.resolution: Chrome launch and accessibility helpers now live in v0b_p1_product_runtime.py; the product capture contract advanced to v3 and binds that small product-only module instead of the legacy capture implementation.
